profile.headline: Software Engineer  | Open to Opportunities
profile.summary: I’m a Software Reliability Engineer with experience building and testing web applications using React, TypeScript and Vitest. I enjoy writing reliable, maintainable code and improving developer workflows through testing and automation. I am always looking to grow my skills while contributing to impactful software.

positions.title: Reliabilty Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contribute to a production React + TypeScript web application.
• Refactor code into reusable components to improve maintainability and scalability. 
• Collaborate in Agile/Scrum workflows including sprint planning and standups.
• Implement frontend validation and workflow handling for dynamic user interactions.
• Used GitHub for version control, managing feature branches, pull requests, and code reviews.

positions.title: Audio Technician
positions.description: Job consists of setting up, tearing down, and running events on the Biola University La Mirada campus. Skills gained include familiarity with sound board.

positions.title: Barista
positions.description: Proficiently managed drive-thru operations took customer orders, and crafted handcrafted beverages. Diligently stocked coffee beans and maintained cleanliness during downtime, ensuring a hygienic and welcoming environment.

positions.title: Fulfillment Associate
positions.description:
Helped Unloaded & process 100k+ packages per night 
Was in charge of managing drivers to dock
Processed paperwork for every truck coming into the station
In charge of assigning employees roles for the unloading of the trucks. 
Help ensure the safety of the trucks before being processed.
Prepared the docking area for the following shift

volunteerExperiences.description: As a volunteer sound engineer at my church, I take pride in managing the audio equipment to ensure that everyone can hear the message clearly during services and events. From adjusting microphone levels to fine-tuning the sound system, I strive to create an immersive worship experience for the congregation. It's a rewarding role that allows me to contribute to the spiritual atmosphere of the church community.
